name: Snapshot

guide.summary: Save the whole dish exactly as it is, to come back to later.
guide.biology: A game tool with no lab analogue: a real culture cannot be stopped and started again exactly where it was.
guide.rules: A snapshot stores the complete state of the dish in a save slot on this device: every organism, every amount and the record of your commands. Loading it continues the dish from that moment, and it goes on exactly as it would have. Nothing is uploaded.
guide.example: Save before a big change, so you can load the dish and try something else from the same moment.

changes: Nothing in the dish: a copy of it is written to a save slot on this device.
doesNotChange: The dish itself. Saving never changes what happens in it.
watchFor: The saved dish in Saved dishes, with the moment it was saved.
